description: Allocation does not support the plain MLP type admitted by shared_experts.
trigger: Construct a TransformerBlock containing BlockSparseMLP(shared_experts=<MLP instance>) and call allocate_q with a valid quantization budget.
expected_behavior: Allocate strategies for the shared MLP's up and down projections.
actual_behavior: TransformerBlock.allocate_q first accesses shared_experts.gates, which MLP does not define; it stores singular up and down instead. GatedMLP agrees with the new list-based accesses. Conversion main calls allocate_q before loading the module, so this API combination fails at allocation; neither inspected built-in sparse-model constructor supplies it.

verification.description: Compared both admitted shared-module implementations with the new attribute reads and the located conversion caller.
verification.limits: Attribute failure inferred from source; no repository execution.

introductions.rationale: The changed shared-expert branch or allocation interface introduces this condition. Built-in model constructors do not pass shared_experts; reach is conditional on that API, with source inspection only and no CUDA reproduction.
